title: Miss Wong Cocktail Bar Siem Reap: Speakeasy Guide
description: Retreat into a cinematic, 1920s Shanghai-inspired speakeasy hidden just one street away from the crushing noise of Siem Reap's main party district.
content:
> **Executive Summary:**
>
> * Miss Wong Cocktail Bar, located one street from Siem Reap's main party district, offers a 1920s Shanghai-inspired speakeasy experience, providing sophisticated cocktails with local ingredients like lemongrass and Kampot pepper.
> * The establishment, open year-round, requires advance booking and features a cinematic, intimate atmosphere with low-fi hip-hop or jazz music, designed for a 2-hour duration with no physical demand.
> * AGS clients receive priority reservations, skip-the-line access, and luxury SUV transfers, ensuring a seamless experience for this smart casual venue.
>
> *Related: Explore our [Premium Southeast Asia Tours](/tours/) luxury itinerary.*

## The AGS Executive Summary
Retreat into a cinematic, 1920s Shanghai-inspired speakeasy hidden just one street away from the crushing noise of Siem Reap's main party district.

## The Operator & Origin Story
Miss Wong was one of the first establishments to prove Siem Reap could support high-end, concept-driven mixology. It provides a sanctuary for travelers seeking sophisticated cocktails without leaving the geographic center of the town.

## The Itinerary & Deep Dive
Step through the red lacquer doors into a deeply atmospheric, dimly lit room decorated with vintage Chinese portraits and heavy red lanterns. 

Acquire a quiet booth. Order signature cocktails that infuse premium spirits with local ingredients like lemongrass, Kampot pepper, and lotus. The music is generally low-fi hip-hop or jazz, allowing for actual conversation—a rarity in this part of town.

## Experience Data
| Metric | Details |
|---|---|
| **Vibe / Atmosphere** | Cinematic, Intimate, Mixology-focused |
| **Duration** | 2 Hours |
| **Physical Demand** | None |
| **Best Paired With** | A sophisticated nightcap in Siem Reap. |

## Siem Reap’s Benchmark Late-Night Speakeasy After Angkor Golf Resort
Hidden behind a glowing red lantern facade on Street 26 just across the river in Siem Reap—8 minutes from [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/), [Amansara](/accommodations/cambodia/amansara/), and [Jaya House River Park](/accommodations/cambodia/jaya-house-river-park/), and 15 minutes from [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/)—**Miss Wong Cocktail Bar** is the undisputed late-night sanctuary for discerning golfers who want world-class mixology far removed from the neon chaos of Pub Street. After an morning round on Sir Nick Faldo’s [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/) or [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/) and a multi-course dinner at [Cuisine Wat Damnak](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-culinary-cuisine-wat-damnak/), stepping into Dean Williams’s 1930s Shanghai-indochine salon feels like entering a private members’ club.

## Signature Khmer-Infused Cocktails & Booth Reservations
* **Botanical & Barrel-Aged Classics:** The bar list pairs pre-Prohibition technique with Cambodian ingredients—highlighted by the *Indochine Martini* (vodka, ginger liqueur, fresh lemongrass, and kaffir lime), the *China White* (jasmine tea-infused gin, lychee, and elderflower), and smoky Negronis stirred with Kampot-pepper vermouth, accompanied by handmade dim sum and spiced cashews.
* **Private Leather Banquettes for Golf Groups:** Because Miss Wong’s intimate dark-wood interior fills quickly after 9:00 PM during the November–March peak golf season, our Siem Reap concierge reserves the central antique leather booths or private rear alcove alongside standby SUV transfers back to [Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang](/accommodations/cambodia/zannier-phum-baitang/) or [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/).

## Seamless Late-Night Transfers From Siem Reap’s Dining Rooms & Golf Resorts
Whether you are wrapping up a bi-weekly Khmer tasting menu at [Cuisine Wat Damnak](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-culinary-cuisine-wat-damnak/), a family-style feast at [The Sugar Palm](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-culinary-the-sugar-palm-siem-reap/), or a sunset gin flight at [Seekers Independent Spirits](/destinations/cambodia/cambodia-culinary-seekers-spirits-siem-reap/) after playing [Angkor Golf Resort](/courses/cambodia/angkor-golf-resort/) and [Phokeethra Country Club](/courses/cambodia/phokeethra/), Miss Wong sits less than five minutes away along the quiet eastern riverbank. Our Siem Reap concierge coordinates standby luxury private touring vehicle pickup directly outside the red-lantern doorway so guests staying at [Zannier Hotels Phum Baitang](/accommodations/cambodia/zannier-phum-baitang/), [Amansara](/accommodations/cambodia/amansara/), [Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor](/accommodations/cambodia/raffles-grand-dangkor/), or [Jaya House River Park](/accommodations/cambodia/jaya-house-river-park/) return effortlessly before their next morning tee time. For private groups of eight or more golfers, we can also arrange a bespoke pre-dinner or post-dinner flight of rare Asian single malts and French cognacs served tableside.

faqs.q: Where is Miss Wong Cocktail Bar located in Siem Reap?
faqs.a: Miss Wong is located on Street 26 on the quiet east bank of the Siem Reap River, just 8 minutes by private SUV from Raffles Grand Hotel d'Angkor and Amansara, and 15 minutes from Angkor Golf Resort.

faqs.q: Does Miss Wong Siem Reap require advance table reservations for golf groups?
faqs.a: Yes. Miss Wong's intimate 1920s Shanghai-style lounge seats limited groups, so Asia Golf Specialists reserves leather booths in advance for 9:00 PM post-dinner arrivals during the peak November–March golf season.

faqs.q: What drinks is Miss Wong Cocktail Bar famous for in Siem Reap?
faqs.a: Miss Wong is renowned for its Indochine Martini (ginger liqueur, kaffir lime, and lemongrass), jasmine-infused gin cocktails, and curated single-malt and cognac pours served with late-night dim sum.
